content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD artificial-eddy-viscosity wave breaking module (BSD header L1-44). Header comment L46-51: with the shock-capturing breaking scheme this file is used for demonstration or bubble/foam calculation when SHOW_BREAKING=T. Two subroutines. (1) WAVE_BREAKING (L60-75): dispatcher — if SHOW_BREAKING calls BREAKING with Mloc,Nloc,ETAx,ETAy,ETAT,Cbrk1,Cbrk2,H,MinDepthFrc,DT,DX,DY,T_brk,AGE_BREAKING (L64-66); else if WAVEMAKER_VIS calls VISCOSITY_WMAKER(Mloc,Nloc,ETAT,visbrk,H,MinDepthFrc,DX,DY) (L68-71, ykchoi 08.19.2015). (2) BREAKING (L87-353): computes breaking eddy viscosity nu_break and breaking age AGE over J=Jbeg-1..Jend+1, I=Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (loop extended to ghost-adjacent rows because source.F uses ghost cells, ykchoi comment L116-117). Per cell: thresholds tmp3=sqrt(g*max(MinDepthFrc,H)), tmp1=Cbrk1*tmp3 (breaking onset etat threshold), tmp2=Cbrk2*tmp3 (cessation threshold) (L124-126); wave direction ANGLE from atan2(-ETAy,-ETAx) in degrees (L129). Compile branch VIS_DEPTH_RATIO (L131-143): when |Eta|/max(Depth,MinDepthFrc)>SWE_ETA_DEP, sets B transition from ETAt vs tmp1 (L137-141) and nu_break=cap1*tmp2*(1+B)+nu_bkg with cap1=total depth (L135,L142). Default branch (L144-348): tmp4=|grad eta| floored by SMALL, moved outside the continuing-breaking logic per 08/04/2019 fix (L146-149); breaking-age event logic — start AGE=DT when ETAt>=tmp1 and AGE==0 or AGE>T_brk (L151-153), else age continuing breaking AGE=AGE+DT (L155-156), else propagate breaking from upwave neighbors: local celerity C=min(|ETAt|/tmp4, sqrt(g|H|)) (L158), propagation times propx/propy/propxy over DX,DY (CARTESIAN scalars L160-165, else per-cell arrays L167-172); if ETAt>=tmp2 the neighbor whose quadrant matches ANGLE (quadrant 1: 0-90 deg uses AGE(I-1,J),AGE(I-1,J-1),AGE(I,J-1) L182-191; quadrant 2: 90-180 L193-202; quadrant 3: -180..-90 uses I+1,J+1 side L204-213; quadrant 4: -90..0 L215-224) seeds AGE(I,J)=DT when a neighbor age exceeds the propagation time. Viscosity assignment (L231-345): wavemaker-local coordinates xmk,ymk (PARALLEL uses iista/jjsta global offsets per ykchoi Jan/23/2018, replacing commented npx/npy forms, L234-244); inside the wavemaker box |xmk-Xc_WK|<Width_WK and |ymk-Yc_WK|<Ywidth_WK/2 (L248-249) breaker age is not used — nu_break=cap1*WAVEMAKER_Cbrk*tmp3+nu_bkg when ETAt>min(tmp2,WAVEMAKER_Cbrk*tmp3) else nu_bkg (L255-260); outside the wavemaker, when 0<AGE<T_brk and ETAt>tmp2 (L264), nu_break per compile option: VIS_KENNEDY_ORIGINAL (L278-294) uses transition threshold etat_star ramping from tmp1 to tmp2 over T_star=5*sqrt(depth/g) of age and nu=cap1*|ETAt|*B+nu_bkg; VIS_KENNEDY (L296-308) drops etat_star (comment: TVD more stable, original transition caused instability) and uses nu=cap1*tmp2*(1+B) with B from tmp1 thresholds; VIS_STATIC_TRANS (L311-312) nu=cap1*tmp3*(Cbrk2+(Cbrk1-Cbrk2)*(T_brk-AGE)/T_brk)+nu_bkg; default (L313-314) static nu=cap1*tmp2+nu_bkg (the pre-transition setting discussed in the 09/17/2016 note L266-277). Roller/undertow block 06/14/2019 (L317-339): C1=max(|ETAt|/tmp4, sqrt(g|H|)) (L325, with the tmp4=0 infinity-protection note L327-328), roller ratio R=|0.45*ETAt/max(C1,SMALL)| capped at 0.1638 (Schaffer et al 1993 20-degree limit, L321-322,L330-331), ROLLER_FLUX=|C1-|U,V||*R*(ETA-ETAmean) (L333-334), UNDERTOW_U/V=-ROLLER_FLUX*cos/sin(ANGLE) (L336-337). Cells failing the breaking test get nu_break=ZERO+nu_bkg (L341-343).

equations.expr: nu_break(I,J)=ZERO+nu_bkg  ! nu_bkg should < 10-6 and is zero for a regular case.

calls: VISCOSITY_WMAKER @L71 (from WAVE_BREAKING, args Mloc,Nloc,ETAT,visbrk,H,MinDepthFrc,DX,DY; not defined in this file)

verbatim_spans.text: ! ykchoi: do loop should start jbeg-1 end jend+1 because
!    I moved tmp4 outside the continuting breaking because tmp4 can be wrong
!   Kennedy et al used a transition for nu, the transition is basically
! its interesting for some compiler that C1 could be infinity if tmp4=0

unresolved: VISCOSITY_WMAKER (called L71) and visbrk (its argument) are defined outside this file

In the VIS_DEPTH_RATIO branch (L131-143), B has no initialization before the IF at L137: if ETAt<=tmp1 neither branch assigns B, so nu_break at L142 uses an undefined/stale B (contrast with explicit B=0.0_SP inits at L287 and L301); also AGE (INTENT(OUT), L112) is never assigned in that compile branch, and cells failing the L133 ratio test get no nu_break assignment

cap2 (declared L102) and imports npx,npy (L96), Nghost, tmp4preview, ROLLER-related use when branch not taken are never referenced in the executed paths of this file; Xc_WK,Yc_WK appear twice in the USE list (L90,L91)

ROLLER_FLUX/UNDERTOW_U/UNDERTOW_V are assigned only inside the breaking branch (L333-337); no reset for non-breaking cells appears in this file, so stale values persist between calls unless cleared elsewhere
tmp1,tmp2,tmp3,tmp4 are not declared locally (L99-113) — they must be module variables from PARAM/GLOBAL; their cross-file scope relation to tmp4preview (imported L94) is not visible here

The quadrant-propagation age seeding (L179-226) executes only when AGE(I,J)==ZERO and ETAt>=tmp2 but ETAt<tmp1 case fell through from L151: the relation tmp1(onset)<tmp2(cessation) requires Cbrk1<Cbrk2 for L179 to be reachable in the ELSE path; actual Cbrk1/Cbrk2 defaults are set elsewhere
IF at L137 (VIS_DEPTH_RATIO) and quadrant tests use ETAt from the dummy argument ETAT (declared as ETAt L111) — case-insensitive Fortran identity assumed
